name: Do Dera
text: Do Dera, also spelled Dadara or Da Deara, was the fool of Lugaid mac Con. At the Battle of Cenn Abrat he put on the royal crown to impersonate the king. The ruse let Lugaid himself escape the field. Do Dera was killed in his master's place. The killer was Eógan of Munster. The episode became a byword for the loyal jester who paid with his life. The tale sits in the cycle of stories around Lugaid and the fall of the Dáirine.
